text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: Wow, really?! So you finally made your debut, then, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep! Just a small step on my path to the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: Whoa, even I've heard of that! It's like a totally crazy, amazing race, right?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: It still doesn't feel real, ya know? Tracen Academy is where all those celebrities on TV graduated from, right?

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: I know what ya mean! It's super crazy that Ines goes to such an elite school! Totally insane!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Hey, you two! Ines is on her break, but you're meant to be throwing out the trash. How long can it take?!

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: Ah crap, it's the manager! Hey, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: We're cheering for ya! Don't really know the deal, but no doubt you'll crush it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, gotcha. Thanks for the support!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One Saturday, Ines Fujin arranges to have a scrimmage with a fellow Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: One… two! Phew! One… two!
choice_data_list: Um… Sorry to keep you waiting.
Um… Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, not at all! I should probably be the one apologizing for getting here so early!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I just love to move my body, y'know! And that includes doing warm-ups!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume with the radiant smile standing before me is Mejiro Ryan, Ines Fujin's roommate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Besides, Ines is at her part-time job, right? I saw her spring out of bed and head out early this morning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She always works right up until practice starts. Says that it's so she can help support her family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: After having seen the way she perseveres from up close, I can't help but be amazed by her mettle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Compared to her, I'm…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: With these hands, I shall deliver the shield to the Mejiro family! This I promise you!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeek! McQueen is just as gallant and sophisticated as ever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …There are still so many areas where I lack experience! I hope to learn as much as I can from you today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, I'm expected to perform well in the Classics, after all! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan is a rising star from an esteemed family. Having this opportunity to scrimmage with her is in and of itself a big win.
choice_data_list: Let's make the most of today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right! Our time may be limited, but I'll pour everything my muscles can muster into this session!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait! It's one o'clock on the dot! Cutting it close, but I made it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ines! I hope work went well! I'm all ready and raring to go!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Ryan! Let me just get a quick warm-up in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the scrimmage between the two begins…

text_block_list.name: Ines & Ryan
text_block_list.text: Great running today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That was awesome, Ines! Your stamina is on a whole different level than before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And your positioning on the the track was flawless! You've improved so much compared to six months ago—it's like you're a different person!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but you still overtook me right at the end, Ryan. Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Argh! I'll definitely win next time! Count on it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I like your moxie. But I won't make it easy for you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And I'm gonna triumph in the Derby, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh… The Derby?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I saw the news on TV during a shift a little while ago. You're gonna compete for the Classic Triple Crown, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: They were saying you're a rising star with the support of the whole Mejiro family behind you, and that you're expected to claim supremacy in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin's gaze is fixed directly on her roommate as she continues.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But the thing is, I absolutely won't allow myself to lose. Not even against someone as incredible as you, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: thinking

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha, it's not that far away. We've got less than a year to go, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll need to be a lot stronger by then—I'm no match for you and the other racers right now, after all.
choice_data_list: But before that comes the Asahi Hai F.S.
But before that comes the Asahi Hai F.S.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right! Competing in that race will help me build the experience I need!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha… And that's why you're taking on a G1 race? You got some real guts.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well, our time here is limited, so I have to do everything I possibly can. Otherwise, it'll all be over before I've even realized it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: As a matter of fact, Ines, I was planning on going to watch this year's Asahi Hai F.S.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! Then that's all the more reason to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yeah, do your best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… You're really something else. Constantly charging ahead without a shred of fear…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wonder what I'll be thinking when I watch you race.
